VydoraAI Review 2026 — My Honest Take After Testing This Faceless Video AI

The vendors — Gaurab Borah and Ram Rawat — have generated over $10,000,000 in combined software launch revenue on JVZoo and WarriorPlus, and run a live YouTube network of 12+ channels that has crossed 10 million views using the exact same system they're selling. I went deep into the full feature set and the JV documentation before the public launch. Here's exactly what you get, what the OTOs cost, and whether the $37 front-end is worth it for someone who wants to build a faceless YouTube income channel in 2026.

What Is VydoraAI?

VydoraAI is a browser-based AI tool that handles the complete faceless video pipeline — from finding a profitable niche, writing the script, generating AI avatar visuals, adding human-like voiceover, optimizing for YouTube SEO, and building in a monetization path — all without you recording a single second of footage.

The core premise: most people fail at YouTube not because they lack effort, but because they have no system. They pick the wrong niche (low CPM), write generic scripts, ignore SEO, and upload into a void. VydoraAI is built to eliminate each of those failure points in a single workflow.

Who Built VydoraAI?

Gaurab Borah and Ram Rawat are the vendors. Ram Rawat — known in the IM space as a prolific product creator — has generated millions in software sales and built a reputation for tools that actually ship and work post-launch. Their combined track record: $10M+ in software revenue, 12+ active YouTube channels, and 10M+ views from faceless video content built using this exact system. This isn't a course built by someone who read about YouTube. It's a tool built by people actively running what they're selling.

The documented network proof: 508,084 views generated in 90 days from faceless AI avatar videos — all in high-CPM niches using this exact system. That's the scale at which the tool has been tested before public release.

The Full Feature Set — What You Actually Get

  • Character Lock System — Keeps your AI avatar visually consistent across every scene.
  • AI Voiceover Engine — Natural human-like voices in 100+ languages. Zero recording.

  • Thumbnail Strategy System — High-CTR thumbnail hooks designed to maximize click-through rate.
  • Built-In Monetization Flow — Affiliate offers integrated into the creation process from step one.

One Stat That Changes How You Think About This

The JV page documents a single faceless video generating $162+ in combined revenue — YouTube ad income from high-CPM placement plus affiliate commissions from the monetization flow built into the video. That's not a promise. That's a documented output from one piece of content in a niche the AI targeted specifically for earning potential.

The Upsells — What Each One Does

OTO 1 — Pro ($67): Unlimited script generation, unlimited SEO, unlimited monthly video exports, 500+ avatars, 100+ voices, 10-minute video length. If you plan to publish more than a handful of videos per month, this is the practical choice.

OTO 2 — MasterMode ($97): Agency-ready edition. Up to 10 team members, full commercial license, 20-minute video capability, 1080p HD, and the proven YouTube ranking strategy guide. Built for agencies or anyone managing multiple channels.

OTO 3 — AI Street Interviews ($47): A completely different content format — keyword to street interview video in 60 seconds. Viral, unfiltered content using the Conversation-As-Traffic Framework.

OTO 4 — AI Selling Room ($47): An AI-powered selling interface that works 24/7 without funnels or autoresponders. Plugs into JVZoo, ClickBank, WarriorPlus, and eCommerce stores.

OTO 5 — Reseller ($297): Keep 100% of profits. Manage up to 100 reseller clients. Full white-label support and done-for-you sales assets.

Verdict

At $37 for the complete faceless video system — including niche research, script generation, AI avatar production, voiceover, SEO, and monetization — this is a strong entry point. The vendors have the track record to back the claims: $10M+ in launches, 10M+ views on their own channels. OTO 1 ($67) is the practical upgrade for anyone serious about publishing consistently. Rating: 4.3/5. Launch window closes May 24, 2026.
